# Security policy

VRCX stores your VRChat login session and a local database of your friends, locations and history, and talks to the VRChat API for you.

## Reporting

Please don't open a public issue. Use [a private security advisory](https://github.com/RealWhyKnot/VRCX/security/advisories/new) so we can work out a fix before anything is published.

I try to reply within 7 days. There's no bug bounty.

## In scope

- Login credentials, cookies or account data sent anywhere other than VRChat.
- A release archive or installer that doesn't match what the release page publishes.
- The app or installer writing outside its own folders.
- A web page, link or other program gaining control of the app without the user's say.

## Out of scope

- Problems in VRChat itself or in services VRCX only links to.
- Problems in a third-party tool you run alongside VRCX.
- Attacks that need admin access to your PC already.
